clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once sat down and decided exactly what he wanted: $50,000 a week, without working for it.

A month later he was in a New York deli, sitting next to a stranger who told him to put his memory course on TV. The same week, a voicemail from an old friend said the exact same thing - from someone else entirely.

Two strangers, two cities, the same idea, the same week. He took the deal.

The checks that followed were real, and he never had to lift a finger again to collect them.

Have you ever asked for something and had it show up twice, uninvited?
